security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' https: data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Updates your apps straight from their GitHub releases
bundle.longDescription: Obtainit tracks apps on GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg and plain web pages, and installs new releases as soon as they are published: AppImages, portable binaries, archives, DEB/RPM/Arch packages, Flatpaks, Windows installers and MSIs.
